dict.string: This app accesses your contacts so you can select and invite people for referrals by sharing app links with them.
This app accesses your photo library so you can select and upload images for your profile, add photos to your service or pandit portfolio, and share these images with users.
This app saves images to your photo library when you download or save shared profile or service portfolio images.
This app uses your camera so you can take photos for updating your profile, adding images to your service or pandit portfolio, and sharing them with users.
